text: Can scan an entire codebase, repo, or folder within a monorepo for security issues
quote: Learn how to set up Semgrep, scan your first project, which can be any codebase, repository, or folder within a monorepo, for security issues, and view your findings.

text: Supports cross-file analysis to detect vulnerabilities that span multiple files/folders
quote: To turn on cross-file analysis, which allows you to detect vulnerabilities across files and folders

text: Can export scan results as a SARIF file
quote: To export the results to a SARIF file: semgrep ci --sarif --sarif-output=semgrep.sarif

text: Supports writing custom rules to control what Semgrep detects in a codebase
quote: you can write custom rules to determine what Semgrep detects in your repositories

text: Provides a Semgrep Editor to write and test detection rules
quote: you can write and test using the [Semgrep Editor]

text: Uses AI-powered detection to identify complex business logic flaws like IDORs and broken authorization
quote: With AI-Powered Detection, you can automatically identify complex business logic flaws, such as IDORs and broken authorization.

text: Rule execution is transparent — users can configure which rules run and inspect the rule syntax behind a finding
quote: Semgrep Code is transparent; you can configure the rules it runs and inspect its syntax to understand how the finding was detected.

text: Semgrep Secrets scans code to detect exposed API keys, passwords, and other credentials
quote: Semgrep Secrets scans code to detect exposed API keys, passwords, and other credentials.

text: Validates detected secrets by testing them against the issuing web service to confirm they are live
quote: valid secrets are those that have been tested against a web service and confirmed to successfully grant resources or authentication. They are actively in use.

text: Posts PR/MR comments to notify developers directly about valid leaked secrets
quote: Semgrep saves security engineers time and effort by prioritizing valid leaked secrets and informs developers of valid secrets in their PRs and MRs by posting comments directly.

text: Flags a vulnerability finding as 'reachable' when a matching code pattern exists in the codebase
quote: If there's a code pattern in the codebase that matches the vulnerability definition, the finding is flagged as reachable.

text: Can generate reports and SBOMs providing a complete inventory of open source components
quote: Generate reports and software bills of materials (SBOM) that provide a complete inventory of your open source components

text: Dynamic Dependency Resolution builds a complete dependency inventory via manifest parsing and repo integration
quote: Supply Chain's Dynamic Dependency Resolution provides a complete inventory of your project's dependencies using a combination of manifest parsing and repository integration

text: Explicitly supports creating Semgrep scan jobs in multiple named CI providers
quote: This guide walks you through creating a Semgrep job in the following CI providers, which are explicitly supported in Semgrep AppSec Platform

text: Managed Scans allow bulk onboarding and scanning of many repositories without CI changes
quote: consider Semgrep Managed Scans, which enables you to bulk onboard and scan your repositories without requiring changes to your CI

text: Can run as a pre-commit hook to stop secrets and security issues before they enter git history
quote: The pre-commit framework can run semgrep when you commit changes. This is helpful in preventing secrets and security issues from leaking into your Git history.

text: Provides an API to list deployments, gather findings, and list projects on the AppSec Platform
quote: Semgrep AppSec Platform provides an API that enables you to list deployments, gather findings created by Semgrep AppSec Platform, and list projects.

text: Analyzes code locally on the user's machine or build environment; code is not uploaded by default
quote: Semgrep analyzes code locally on your computer or in your build environment: by default, code is never upload

text: CLI command 'semgrep ci' runs a full scan against the repository
quote: navigate to the root of your project, and run your first scan: semgrep ci

text: Custom rules can automate code review comments, enforce secure coding practices, and scan configuration files
quote: you can write rules that: Automate code review comments. Identify secure coding violations. Scan configuration files.

text: Findings can trigger alerts, notifications, or automatically create tracking tickets
quote:
Triage findings
Send alerts and notifications or create tickets to track findings identified by Semgrep Code

text: Supply Chain scanning can detect malicious dependencies associated with supply-chain attacks
quote: Detect malicious dependencies associated with Supply Chain attacks

text: Automatically scans repositories on events like pushes and pull/merge requests
quote: your development cycle benefits from the automated scanning of repositories at various events, such as: Push events, Pull requests or merge requests

text: Installable via pipx or uv as a CLI tool
quote:
pipx install semgrep

# preferred: install through uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)
uv tool install semgrep

text: 'semgrep scan' command runs local codebase scans without requiring a Semgrep account
quote: semgrep scan - This is the recommended command for scanning local codebases or scanning a project when you don't have a Semgrep account

text: Semgrep Supply Chain is an SCA tool that detects vulnerabilities introduced by open source dependencies
quote: Semgrep Supply Chain is a software composition analysis (SCA) tool that detects security vulnerabilities in your codebase introduced by open source dependencies.

text: Semgrep Assistant (AI) contextually post-processes findings to reduce noise by about 20%
quote: Contextual post-processing of findings with Semgrep Assistant (AI) to further reduce noise by ~20%

text: Supply Chain determines project dependencies then scans using rules that assess vulnerability reachability
quote: Supply Chain first determines the list of dependencies and versions in the code, then scans your codebase using rules that specify... the vulnerability's reachability

text: Supports 30+ languages and can run in an IDE, as a pre-commit check, or in CI/CD
quote: Semgrep supports 30+ languages and can run in an IDE, as a pre-commit check, and as part of CI/CD workflows.
